title: 第17章 无知妇人第18章 圣旨到
lines: “二哥，就这样放过这个野种了？”
宁茂盯着宁宸的背影，恶狠狠地说道。
宁兴道：“父亲最近不知道什么了？突然对宁宸态度大变，要是我们打伤了宁宸，保不齐会被父亲斥责。”
“最重要的是大哥明天殿试，别影响到他。”
宁茂点点头，摸着身上的大氅，疑惑道：“你说这野种从哪儿弄来的这件大氅？这领子应该狐嗦。”
狐嗦乃是狐狸脖子下面一小块，最为暖和，十分珍贵，价格不菲。
宁兴冷哼一声，“肯定是偷别人的，野种就是野种，缺乏管教，他被找回来前以乞讨为生，小偷小摸很正常。”
另一边，宁宸将柴叔送到府门口。
他悄悄塞给柴叔四两银子，自己留了一两，以备不时之需。
“四公子，这...这我不能要。”
“拿着，你不要，我可生气了！”
柴叔推辞了好几次，最后还是拗不过宁宸，只能收着。
“四公子，老奴不在，你以后一定要保护好自己，别跟他们发生冲突，你占不到便宜的。”
宁宸点头，“我知道，柴叔放心...等我以后离开宁府，有了自己住的地方，再请柴叔回来。”
“好，老奴等着四公子，以后还伺候你！”
柴叔一步三回头，依依不舍地离开了。
宁宸心里空落落地，返回宁府。
与此同时，宁自明也从宫里出来了。
他脸色煞白，浑身冰冷。
不过庆幸地是，玄帝只是训斥了他一顿，并没有过多责罚。
马车就在宫门口不远处。
吴管家看到宁自明出来，满脸殷勤地迎上来，看到宁自明脸色不对，担心地问道：“老爷，您没事吧？”
宁自明没说话，登上马车，让吴管家快回府。
他到现在都心惊胆颤，两腿发软，遍体生寒。
宁府，宁茂正在向常如月展示身上的大氅。
常如月满脸高兴，忍不住夸赞：“好看好看...我儿现在越来越优秀了！”
“你父亲交代过，别为难宁宸...但这野种断不可留，宁家乃是你们兄弟三个的。”
“所以，以后对付宁宸，要动脑子，不能蛮干...你们这次就做的很好。”
宁茂愈发得意了。
便在这时，下人前来禀报，说是宁自明回来了。
常如月急忙起身到门口迎接。
宁自明已经到了院子。
进到屋子里后，常如月才注意到宁自明脸色煞白，眼神惶恐。
“老爷，您没事吧？”
一边说，一边赶紧给宁自明倒了杯茶。
回到家，宁自明才觉得安心了些。
“宁宸回来了吗？”
见宁自明一回来就问宁宸，常如月眼底闪过一抹阴狠之色。
老爷最近对宁宸越来越上心，问缘由他又不肯说，再这样下去，宁府哪还有她们母子的容身之处？所以，必须想办法除掉宁宸...常如月心里恶毒地想着。
但脸上却不动声色，语气也很温柔：“老爷放心，人已经回来了...我刚让人炖了鸡汤给他送过去。”
宁自明满意地点点头，觉得常如月真是他的贤内助。
content_en:
"Second brother, are you going to let this bastard go like this?"
Ning Mao stared at Ning Chen's back and said viciously.
Ning Xing said: "What has Father not known recently? His attitude towards Ning Chen has suddenly changed drastically. If we injure Ning Chen, we will be scolded by Father if we fail to protect him."
"The most important thing is that the eldest brother will take the palace exam tomorrow, so don't affect him."
Ning Mao nodded, touched the cloak on his body, and asked doubtfully: "Where do you think this bastard got this cloak? This collar should be furry."
The fox's fur is a small piece under the fox's neck. It is the warmest, very precious and expensive.
Ning Xing snorted coldly, "He must have stolen from others. A bastard is a bastard and lacks discipline. He made a living by begging before he was found. Petty theft is normal."
On the other side, Ning Chen sent Uncle Chai to the door of the house.
He quietly gave Uncle Chai four taels of silver and kept one tael for himself in case of emergency.
"Fourth Young Master, this...I can't have this."
"Take it, if you don't want it, I'll be angry!"
Uncle Chai declined several times, but in the end he couldn't resist Ning Chen and had no choice but to accept it.
"Fourth Young Master, I'm not here. You must protect yourself from now on and don't conflict with them. You won't get any advantage."
Ning Chen nodded, "I know, don't worry, Uncle Chai... When I leave Ning Mansion and have my own place to live, I can invite Uncle Chai back."
"Okay, this old slave is waiting for you, Fourth Young Master, and I will serve you in the future!"
Uncle Chai turned back three times in one step and left reluctantly.
Ning Chen felt empty and returned to Ning Mansion.
At the same time, Ning Ziming also came out of the palace.
His face was pale and his whole body was cold.
Fortunately, Emperor Xuan just scolded him and didn't punish him too much.
The carriage is not far from the palace gate.
When Butler Wu saw Ning Ziming coming out, he came up to him with a face full of hospitality. Seeing that Ning Ziming's face looked wrong, he asked worriedly: "Master, are you okay?"
Ning Ziming said nothing, got on the carriage and asked Butler Wu to return home quickly.
He is still frightened, his legs are weak, and his whole body is cold.
Ning Mansion, Ning Mao is showing off his cloak to Chang Ruyue.
Chang Ruyue's face was full of joy and she couldn't help but praise: "It looks so good...my son is getting better and better now!"
"Your father told you not to embarrass Ning Chen...but you must not keep this bastard. The Ning family belongs to you three brothers."
"So, when dealing with Ning Chen in the future, you have to use your brain and not act recklessly... You did a good job this time."
Ning Mao became more and more proud.
At this moment, a servant came to report that Ning Ziming was back.
Chang Ruyue hurriedly got up and went to the door to greet her.
Ning Ziming has arrived at the yard.
After entering the house, Chang Ruyue noticed that Ning Ziming's face was pale and his eyes were frightened.
"Master, are you okay?"
While talking, he quickly poured a cup of tea for Ning Ziming.
After returning home, Ning Ziming felt more at ease.
"Is Ning Chen back?"
Seeing Ning Ziming asking Ning Chen as soon as he came back, a sinister look flashed in Chang Ruyue's eyes.
The master has become more and more attracted to Ning Chen recently, and he refused to tell me why. If this continues, how can there be room for their mother and son in the Ning Mansion? Therefore, we must find a way to get rid of Ning Chen... Chang Ruyue thought viciously in her heart.
But his face remained calm and his tone was very gentle: "Don't worry, sir, he's back... I just asked someone to stew chicken soup and send it to him."
Ning Ziming nodded with satisfaction, feeling that Chang Ruyue was really his good wife.
